concerns.text: FR-002 and spec US-1 require simulation across Sparsity levels {0.1, 0.2, 0.4}. Task T016 explicitly configures simulators only for {0.2, 0.4}, omitting 0.1. No other task covers the missing sparsity level.

FR-006 and spec US-3 require sensitivity analysis on Alpha thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}. Task T040 description contains a malformed placeholder 'Alpha thresholds {, conventional significance levels, 0.10}', failing to define the required set. No other task covers the missing alpha values.

FR-004 and spec Edge Cases require excluding true-zero coefficients from the power denominator. Task T032 is marked unimplemented ('[ ]') and is the only task explicitly addressing this logic. Without it, the power calculation in T029 is incomplete.

FR-007 and Constitution Principle VII require recording selected variables and decision thresholds for every simulation. Task T027 is marked unimplemented ('[ ]') and is the only task assigned to write these records to `data/processed/simulation_results.csv`.
FR-005 requires Kruskal-Wallis and Dunn's post-hoc tests on simulation-level data. Tasks T037 and T038 are marked unimplemented ('[ ]'). No other task implements these statistical tests.
FR-001 requires downloading exactly 10 datasets. Task T001 is marked unimplemented ('[ ]') and is the only task assigned to this requirement.

FR-008 and SC-003 require completion within 6 hours. Task T045 (performance optimization/parallelization) is marked unimplemented ('[ ]') and is critical for meeting the runtime constraint on 2 vCPUs.
